project: The Black Olive Rooftop Cafe & Restaurant

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-light tracking-tighter uppercase

typography.guidelines: Use 'Cormorant Garamond' for all primary headings to establish editorial luxury. Avoid bolding headings excessively; lean into 'font-light'. 'Outfit' is for body copy and navigational elements for sharp, sterile clarity.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for sticky header: 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/70 border-b border-[#C5A059]/10'. Use solid matte backgrounds for general content sections.
visual_enhancers.effects: Subtle grain texture overlay over dark backgrounds to avoid digital flatness. Soft glow effects specifically around gold/neon elements.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid delicate borders using 'border_subtle' for defining cards or menu sections.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for floating elements, no hard dropdown shadows.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-12, p-16, p-24 for section paddings. Luxury needs negative space.
layouts.grid: Bento 'Tetris' Grid for the photo gallery. Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix shapes (e.g., col-span-8 row-span-2, col-span-4 row-span-1) to create asymmetry and tension.
layouts.hero: Full screen (h-[100svh]). Kinetic text reveal for the brand name. The hero image MUST have a 'bg-black/50' overlay so the text pops beautifully.
layouts.menu_section: Categories: Coffee, Fast Food, Fine Dining, Desserts, South Indian. Use an elegant list layout with dotted leader lines (or minimalist flex layout) connecting item names to prices. Avoid boxed cards.
layouts.footer: Massive py-32 padding. Feature the Gold Neon Olive-Branch Logo large.

motion.scroll: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling is MANDATORY. It adds physical weight and luxury to the page.
motion.entrance: Framer Motion: fade-up and slow-reveal for typography and images. Use staggerChildren for the menu lists and gallery items.
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for a slow, organic 'Editorial Ribbon' across the screen displaying the brand ethos or 'ROOFTOP CAFE & RESTAURANT'.

components_and_features.button: Sharp rectangular or subtle pill. Solid gold background ('bg-[#C5A059]') with black text, or outline style ('border border-[#C5A059] text-[#C5A059]'). Hover must show slight lift ('-translate-y-1') and color brightness shift.
components_and_features.map: Embed Google Maps iframe for Rajkot location. Use CSS filters (e.g., 'filter: invert(90%) hue-rotate(180deg)') if possible to make it dark mode friendly, or blend it seamlessly into a dark container.
components_and_features.testimonials: Carousel for 5 customer testimonials. Use Framer Motion or Swiper. Keep UI minimalist: large elegant quote marks, delicate typography for the review.
components_and_features.SEO_AEO: Ensure proper semantic HTML tags (<header>, <main>, <section>, <article>, <nav>). Add descriptive alt tags to images. Ensure fast load times via proper image sizing (Tailwind aspect-ratio or strict w/h classes where applicable).

images.description: Night exterior of the rooftop cafe. Use as the main hero background covering the screen.
Wood interior with teal chairs. Place as a dominant image in the asymmetric gallery section.
Long dining hall with waiter. Ideal for the 'About / Story manifesto' section next to text.
Wooden pendant lamp detail. Use in the gallery grid as a smaller accent block (e.g. col-span-4).
Gold neon olive-branch logo on black. Prominently display in the footer or an interstitial section.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: No generic centered layouts; prioritize asymmetric grids, left-aligned typography blocks, and sophisticated editorial arrangements.
Do not use fully transparent header backgrounds over images without blur. Always use backdrop-blur with a semi-transparent dark tint.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters anywhere in the UI. Use sleek SVG icons (lucide-react) if necessary.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='call-to-book-button').
Include hover states and micro-animations for all interactable elements. Static equals dead.
The codebase uses .js files, NOT .tsx. Adapt your component syntax and Framer Motion imports accordingly.
Do NOT add '.App { text-align: center; }'. It breaks natural reading flow.
Create 5 realistic, high-quality placeholder testimonials focusing on ambiance, food, and the rooftop view.
Ensure images are wrapped in containers that prevent stretching and maintain layout aspect ratios.
Only use the provided real photo URLs, no placeholders.
